summary: Viking Global Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, reporting (i) Amendment No. 1 to its unsecured convertible promissory note originally issued April 7, 2025 to FK Venture LLC, extending maturity from September 30, 2026 to the earlier of April 1, 2027 or a senior secured lender default, and resetting the conversion price to $0.15 per share, or $0.02 upon a Senior P. Note Default, and (ii) a new $300,000 short-term note issued by subsidiary Viking Protection Systems, LLC to two accredited investors, maturing December 31, 2026, with a fixed 10% interest amount, guaranteed by CEO James A. Doris. This is routine debt financing, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is named.
